description: A short-lived, single-use link on our site where YOUR end user connects their own account (a sign-in, with any code or check it asks for, or a session string), so you never handle their password. type create (default) connects a new account; type reconnect with account_id reconnects that one and keeps its account_id. Optional: name (your own reference, passed back in the redirect and every event), expires_on (5 minutes to 24 hours, default 1 hour), success_redirect_url and failure_redirect_url (https; status, account_id, name and reason are added to the query), notify_url (https; receives account.connected, account.reconnect_required and account.disconnected for that account, signed with the webhook_secret this answer shows once). Free. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: For type reconnect: the account_id to reconnect.

expires_on.description: ISO 8601 date and time, 5 minutes to 24 hours from now. Default 1 hour.

failure_redirect_url.description: https URL the end user is sent to when the link cannot succeed.

name.description: Your own reference for the account, such as your user id.

notify_url.description: https URL that receives this account's signed events.

success_redirect_url.description: https URL the end user is sent to once connected.

type.description: create (default) for a new account, reconnect for an existing one.

name: account_connect_link
title: Create a Hosted Connect Link
